title: Oxva Oneo Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: Step up your vaping game with the OXVA ONEO and these Replacement Fixed-Coil Pods, fitted with revolutionary Unicoil technology. These game-changing pods ensure a virtually leak-free experience, making sure that not a single drop of your prized e-liquid goes to waste. From the seasoned DTL vaper to those who favour a tighter MTL draw, the ONEO replacement pods have got you covered. Take your pick from three resistance levels, each designed to cater to different power needs: Don't settle for anything less than tailored perfection. With the OXVA ONEO Replacement Pods, you can fine-tune your vaping adventure to meet your every need. 0.4OHM: Perfect for a smooth DTL hit at 28-34W - High VG 70% best used with this pod. 0.6OHM: A balanced experience RDL at 20-26W - Nic Salts best used with this pod. 0.8OHM: For a more intense MTL feel, ideal at 14-18W Nic Salts Or 50/50 E-Liquid best used with this pod. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
